summary: Guide authoring from dated coursework through searchable prior evidence, profile review and practice generation; reserve newly available evidence for reruns and make large libraries searchable and paginated.
rationale: D-015 supersedes optional coursework targets and emergent evidence at initial creation. Profile history, original sources, scoring and verifier thresholds remain unchanged; v1 generation scope stays enforced.
authorization: Explicit user browser comments and “Do them”: require existing coursework with a deadline, inline creation, emergent material only at rerun, autocomplete evidence selection, clearer sequence and matching agent MCP behavior.
validation: 159 backend tests including REST/MCP and v1 compatibility; authoring browser journey with 22-file library, keyboard search, inline coursework prerequisites and narrow-screen screenshots; frontend build, rich-labs and experience browser journeys, Ruff, skill validation and architecture checks. No real learner records or model calls used for tests.
rollback: Revert paired frontend/domain/schema/docs/skill changes. No data migration; preserve existing coursework, profile versions and generated sets. Restart the local API and rebuild the frontend.
